title: rewake mod protocol v1
description: The protocol between the mod inside the harness and its run's wrapper: HTTP/1.1 over the run's mod socket, every endpoint a POST with a JSON body under /v1/, every request checked by its peer (docs/v2/stage4-space.md#2-the-protocol). An endpoint answers 200 with its answer, or another status with a Refusal. tools/protogen writes the Go and TypeScript types from this file; edit it, never them.

maxBodyBytes.description: is the largest request body the endpoint reads; a longer one is refused before it is parsed.

maxWaitSeconds.description: is the longest the endpoint holds a request before it answers, since the mod's fetch gives up after 30 seconds; a longer wait is a loop of polls.

maxEndBodyBytes.description: is the largest turn/end body the endpoint reads, in place of maxBodyBytes, counted in the UTF-8 bytes of the whole JSON body: a turn's answer can be longer than the other requests, and the mod cuts one that would pass it, saying how much it left out.

aliveHoldSeconds.description: is how long the endpoint holds a mod/alive poll before it answers; the mod sends the next at once.

screenHoldSeconds.description: is how long the endpoint holds a workers/screen poll whose screen has not changed before it answers the same screen; the mod sends the next at once.

viewIdleSeconds.description: is how long the endpoint keeps a worker's screen open with no workers request naming it; the next one opens it again.

maxScreenSide.description: is the most columns or rows workers/resize takes, a Raster's widest.

aliveLapseSeconds.description: is how long the endpoint waits for the next mod/alive poll, from the last one's arrival or the hello's, before the load's heartbeat lapses and what the mod proved is withdrawn.

x-endpoints.description: is the first request of every load of the mod.
reports a turn's start of the session's own conversation, from the mod of every role.

reports a turn's end of the session's own conversation, from the mod of every role, retried with the same end id until its receipt comes; 410 says the run is proven gone, so the end has no destination and is not sent again.

is the heartbeat of an admitted load: a poll held for aliveHoldSeconds and sent again as soon as it is answered; a poll of a lapsed or older generation of the current load is refused with 409, on which the newest generation's chain says hello again, and a poll of a superseded load with 410, on which it stops.
asks which of the runs whose unacknowledged ends the harness's store keeps rewake proves ended, so an admitted load may remove their entries; it changes nothing on the host.
acknowledges a control request or reports its final outcome.
lists the workers of the spaces this run opened that are not over, for the workers' pane (docs/v2/workers-panel.md); served only to a run that hosts spaces, 404 otherwise.
is a long poll of one worker's screen: answered once its sequence passes the one asked, or after screenHoldSeconds with the same; 404 names a worker not listed or whose screen cannot be reached.
types into one worker, answered once the keys are written to its terminal.
sets one worker's terminal size, the pane's body less its own lines; the last size set, here or by rewake attach, stands.

WorkersAnswer.description: is the workers, in the order their spaces opened.

Worker.description: is one space's worker, as rewake list knows it; a field nobody observed is absent.

space.description: is the space's id, which the other workers requests name.

harness.description: is the worker's harness, by its adapter id.

state.description: is the space's state: opening, open or closing.

activity.description: is the worker's turn, working or idle.

effort.description: is the worker's configured reasoning effort.

percent.description: is how full the worker's context is.

ScreenRequest.description: asks for one worker's screen once it is past a sequence.

space.description: names the worker by its space.

after.description: is the sequence of the screen the mod has, 0 for none.

ScreenAnswer.description: is a worker's whole screen as a Raster draws it.

seq.description: is the screen's sequence, the after of the next poll.

columns.description: is the screen's width in cells.

rows.description: is the screen's height in cells.

cells.description: is every cell, row-major, as a Raster's cells: base64 of little-endian u32 triplets, a width-1 code point, the foreground and the background as 0x00RRGGBB or 0x01000000 for the default; the visible cursor is drawn inverse.

ended.description: says the worker's output is over: the screen changes no more.

KeysRequest.description: is what to type into one worker.

space.description: names the worker by its space.

keys.description: are the bytes a terminal sends for the keys, as UTF-8.

ResizeRequest.description: is a size for one worker's terminal.

space.description: names the worker by its space.

Refusal.description: is the answer of an endpoint that did not do what was asked, with a status other than 200.

error.description: says why, in words for a person.

loadSeq.description: is, on a hello refused 410 for a number below the current load's, that load's number: a load whose store shows no number above its own takes the next above this one and says hello once more.

Done.description: is the answer of an endpoint that did what was asked and has nothing to say.

HelloRequest.description: is what a load of the mod says of itself.

loadId.description: names this load of the mod; a reload is a new load, and every later request carries the id its hello gave.

sessionId.description: is the harness's id of the conversation the load runs in.

harnessVersion.description: is the harness's version as the mod reads it.

loadSeq.description: orders the run's loads: each load takes the next number of a counter the harness's store keeps for the run, so a later load's is higher; a hello is bound only with a number above the run's current load's, the same number is that load's retry, and a lower one is refused 410 as superseded.

HelloAnswer.description: is what the run is, for this load.

role.description: is the run's role, as rewake's role catalogue names it.

hostsSpaces.description: says whether the run's wrapper hosts spaces, so the mod registers the keeper and polls events.

generation.description: is the load's heartbeat generation, which every mod/alive poll of this hello carries; a retried hello of a live generation gets the same one.

AliveRequest.description: is one poll of a load's heartbeat.

loadId.description: is the load polling, the one its admitted hello named.

generation.description: is the heartbeat generation the hello answered.

EndedRequest.description: names the other runs whose ends the harness's store keeps.

epochs.description: are up to 32 epochs of other runs, as the store's index names them.

EndedAnswer.description: says which of the asked runs rewake proves ended: of another boot, or their wrapper gone with its start time.

ended.description: are the epochs proven ended; one alive or that cannot be told is left out.

TurnStartRequest.description: is a turn's start of the session's own conversation; a subagent's turn is not sent.

loadId.description: is the load that saw the start.

conversation.description: is the conversation the turn runs in.

TurnEndRequest.description: is a turn's end of the session's own conversation, sent again with the same end id until its receipt comes.

loadId.description: is the admitted load sending the end, which need not be the load that saw it: a later load of the run sends what an earlier one stored, and the end stays its end id and its content.

conversation.description: is the conversation the turn ran in.

endId.description: names this end once and for good: the same end sent again carries the same id and is taken once.

answer.description: is the turn's final text, or what the harness said of its failure; cut by the mod at the last whole character that keeps the body within maxEndBodyBytes, with a line saying how many characters were left out; absent when the turn gave none.

EndReason.description: is why a turn ended, mapped from the harness's own reason.

Receipt.description: says the core took a turn's start or end.

endId.description: is the end taken; absent for a start.

ControlCommand.description: is one command for the current heartbeat generation.

AliveAnswer.description: may carry one command; the next heartbeat never waits for its completion.

control.description: is the command dispatched once to this generation.

StateRequest.description: is a complete current observation, without transcript content.

model.description: is the configured model, absent when unknown.

tokens.description: is current input context usage, absent when unknown.

window.description: is the context window, absent when unknown.

percent.description: is the filled percentage, absent when unknown.

compacting.description: says a native compaction is in progress.

compactions.description: counts completed compactions observed by this load.

request.description: names the latest completed compaction request, empty for native compaction.

from.description: names its requester, empty for native compaction.

ControlReply.description: is an initial or final result for a dispatched command.

outcome.description: is requested, done, refused or failed.

reason.description: is the fixed control reason, when known.

detail.description: explains the outcome without transcript content.

open.description: says the native outcome is not yet known.

tokensBefore.description: is context usage before compaction, when supplied.

tokensAfter.description: is context usage after compaction, when supplied.
